To measure exactly 45 minutes using two ropes that burn for one hour but at non-uniform rates, follow these steps:

1. Light one rope (Rope A) from both ends and the other rope (Rope B) from one end simultaneously.  
2. When Rope A is completely burned (after 30 minutes), light the other end of Rope B.  
3. When Rope B is completely burned, exactly 45 minutes will have passed.  

This works because burning Rope A from both ends halves its burn time to 30 minutes, and lighting the second end of Rope B at that point causes it to burn for the remaining 15 minutes (since 30 minutes had already passed).
